items.title: How to Get a Salon Worthy Blowout at Home
items.summary: A great blowout isn't just about technique. It's about working with your hair type, protecting your hair from heat, and creating a routine that builds smoothness, volume, and shine from the start. Whether your hair is straight, wavy, curly, or coily, understanding how heat changes your hair's structure can help you achieve longer-lasting results with less damage. Key Takeaways The best blowouts start with clean, conditioned hair that's matched to your hair type. Heat protection is essential for helping reduce moisture loss and protecting the hair cuticle. Drying your hair in sections creates smoother, longer-lasting results. Allowing each section to cool helps lock in shape and volume. Lightweight styling products help support movement, reduce frizz, and improve longevity without weighing hair down. Why Hair Prep Matters Your blowout starts long before you pick up a blow dryer. Healthy-looking blowouts begin with hair that's clean, hydrated, and conditioned for your hair type. Product buildup, excess oil, or dehydrated hair can all affect how your style looks and how long it lasts. Wash your hair with your Function of Beauty Custom Shampoo and Conditioner, personalized for your hair type and goals. If your goal is hydration, frizz control, or strengthening, your formula is designed to support those needs before styling even begins. After washing, gently squeeze excess water from your hair with a microfiber towel or cotton T-shirt instead of rubbing, which can create unnecessary friction and frizz. Step 1: Apply Your Styling Products The best time to apply styling products is while your hair is still damp. Choose products based on the result you want to achieve: Custom Styling Primer helps protect against heat while smoothing the hair and reducing frizz. Formulated with provitamin B5 that provides color, UV, and heat protection (up to 450°F). Formulated for your unique hair goals with a personalized level of hold. Size: 6 oz Custom Hair Serum at the ends adds lightweight hydration and shine while helping smooth the hair cuticle. Formulated with sunflower seed oil and jojoba oil that smooths frizz, enhances shine, and protect hair from heat. The lightweight formula is fit for all hair types. Size: 3 oz Zero Gravity Mousse provides flexible volume and body without making hair feel stiff. Mousse adds volume, structure, and hold to a blowout. When activated by the heat of a blow dryer, its polymers expand to plump each hair strand and create lift at the roots. Distribute products evenly from mid-lengths to ends, adding mousse closer to the roots if you're looking for extra lift. Step 2: Rough Dry First Instead of immediately reaching for a round brush, begin by rough drying your hair until it's about 70-80% dry. Use your fingers to lift the roots while directing airflow downward. This removes excess moisture, shortens styling time, and reduces the amount of heat your hair experiences overall. Step 3: Choose the Right Tools Your technique matters, but so do your tools. Always use a concentrator nozzle on your blow dryer. Focused airflow helps smooth the cuticle for a shinier finish while giving you better control. Choose your brush based on your styling goals: Large round brush: Creates volume and movement. Medium round brush: Adds body with soft bends. Paddle brush: Creates a sleek, smooth finish. Step 4: Work in Sections Divide your hair into manageable sections before styling. Working with smaller sections allows heat to reach each piece evenly while maintaining the tension needed for a smooth finish. Place your brush underneath each section and slowly pull through while following closely with your dryer. Keep the airflow moving from roots to ends to encourage the cuticle to lie flat. Continue until each section is completely dry before moving to the next. Step 5: Let Your Hair Cool Heat temporarily reshapes the hydrogen bonds inside your hair, but cooling is what helps set your style. After drying each section, leave it wrapped around the brush or pin it loosely for several seconds before releasing. This simple step helps improve volume, bounce, and longevity. Step 6: Finish Your Style Once your hair has completely cooled, finish with a few drops of Custom Hair Serum through the mid-lengths and ends for added shine and frizz control. If you want additional volume, gently lift your roots with your fingertips instead of adding more heat. Blowout Tips by Hair Type Straight Hair Use lightweight styling Zero Gravity Mousse in small amounts at the root to avoid weighing hair down and focus on creating lift at the roots for long-lasting volume. Wavy Hair Work in smaller sections to smooth the hair while preserving natural movement with your round brush after applying Zero Gravity Mousse at the root. Add Styling Primer to help minimize humidity-related frizz and hold your style. Curly Hair If you're creating a smooth blowout, allow curls to stretch gradually rather than forcing them straight in one pass. Working slowly helps reduce unnecessary heat exposure. Work in smaller sections to smooth the hair while preserving natural movement with your round brush after applying Zero Gravity Mousse at the root. Add Styling Primer to help minimize humidity-related frizz and hold your style. Coily Hair Begin with well-conditioned hair and use smaller sections with consistent tension. Taking your time creates smoother results while helping protect the hair's structure. Work in smaller sections to smooth the hair while preserving natural movement with your round brush after applying Zero Gravity Mousse at the root. Add Styling Primer to help minimize humidity-related frizz and hold your style. The Bottom Line A salon-worthy blowout isn't about using the highest heat or the most products. It's about understanding how your hair responds to moisture, heat, and styling. When you start with products personalized to your hair type and goals, protect your hair during styling, and use the right technique, you can create a smooth, voluminous blowout that lasts longer while helping keep your hair healthy over time.
